chapters.label: hello
chapters.text: Meet OpenBot. Your own team of AI teammates. For the work you care about, and the things you'd rather have taken care of.

chapters.label: yours
chapters.text: Create a teammate. Give it a role, a personality, and your choice of AI. Bring a supported subscription, an API key, or a local model.

chapters.label: apps
chapters.text: Say you're preparing a launch. Your teammate can work with email, calendars, websites, and the Mac apps and files you allow. When it needs a sign-in, you take over.

chapters.label: team
chapters.text: One teammate researches. Another builds. Another checks the details. They consult each other, and bring one coordinated answer back to you.

chapters.label: work
chapters.text: Not just a summary. A presentation you can use. A spreadsheet you can open. A website. Code changes with tests and a pull request to review.

chapters.label: routines
chapters.text: Make useful work a routine. Keep preferences in memory. Teach a workflow, save a skill, and connect more tools through MCP. Build on what already works.

chapters.label: extend
chapters.text: And if a tool is missing? Review its plan. Approve it. Your chosen coding model continues the task, building a tool you can inspect or remove.

chapters.label: control
chapters.text: You set the boundaries. Review sensitive actions before they happen. See the work behind the result, and step in when you're needed.

chapters.label: everywhere
chapters.text: Start on your Mac. Continue from your iPhone. The same conversations, teammates, and work, within reach.

chapters.label: open
chapters.text: Open source. Local first. Yours to shape. OpenBot. A little team. A lot more possible.
